title: Oozy Crispy Korean Dark Chocolate Songpyeon
description: A crispy and adventurous Korean dessert featuring dark chocolate and ssam-wrap, made with tamasic-friendly ingredients. This unique treat combines the flavors of Korea with the richness of dark chocolate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the rice flour, coconut sugar, and salt.
Add the sesame oil to the bowl and stir until the mixture forms a crumbly dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a few dark chocolate chips in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the chocolate to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the songpyeon.
Place the songpyeon on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the tops with sesame oil.
Bake the songpyeon for 15 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Allow the songpyeon to cool for a few minutes before serving with ssam wrap and optional crushed nuts and sesame seeds.
